schema.title: Sound asset
schema.description: Specification for the asset type for loading sound files

sound_file.description: The path of the file relative to the current asset directory

description: The new audio asset is a sound file intended for background music. Its file resides at audio/background_music.ogg within the current asset directory, and the file is stored in OGG format. This asset should be referenced as a sound type in the project's resource manifest.
